-- Encens - α-Pinène
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_typical, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, is_signature, source)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 40.0, 30.0, 55.0, 'majeur', 1, 'Tisserand & Young (2014). Essential Oil Safety'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Encens%' AND m.name LIKE '%Pinène%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
